title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Maria went on a trip to the mountains with her brother. They took a small bus from the city early in the morning. The road was long and winding, but the view from the window was beautiful. They arrived at a small village at noon.

After lunch, they walked up a path to a big lake. The water was very cold, so they only put their feet in it. In the evening, they sat by a fire and told stories. Maria said it was the best trip of her life.

questions.text: How did Maria and her brother travel to the mountains?
What did they do in the cold water of the lake?
options: They put their feet in it

questions.text: Why did Maria and her brother only put their feet in the lake?
options: The water was too cold to swim in

questions.text: How did Maria feel about the trip at the end of the day?
options: She was very happy with it

vocabulary.definition: a small place where people live, smaller than a town

paragraph_translations: El verano pasado, Maria hizo un viaje a las montañas con su hermano. Tomaron un autobús pequeño de la ciudad temprano por la mañana. El camino era largo y sinuoso, pero la vista desde la ventana era hermosa. Llegaron a un pequeño pueblo al mediodía.

Después del almuerzo, subieron por un sendero hasta un lago grande. El agua estaba muy fría, así que solo metieron los pies. Por la noche, se sentaron junto a una fogata y contaron historias. Maria dijo que era el mejor viaje de su vida.
